starters.title: Copper patina shader
starters.prompt: Make me a shader editor for a weathered copper material: a node graph where a noise texture and an edge mask drive green patina over brushed copper into a Principled BSDF and Material Output, with a material slot header and a sidebar of the selected node's settings.

starters.title: Forest scatter (geometry nodes)
starters.prompt: A geometry nodes editor that scatters pine trees and rocks on a terrain: Distribute Points on Faces, Instance on Points, Random Value for scale and rotation, Join Geometry, plus a modifier panel with density, seed, scale range and a viewport/render toggle.

starters.title: Campfire particles
starters.prompt: A particle system properties panel for a campfire: emission (count, frame start/end, lifetime), velocity, physics, a color ramp for flame color over lifetime, a size curve, render-as dropdown and a cache panel with a bake progress bar.

starters.title: Product turntable render
starters.prompt: Render settings for a 360° product turntable: Cycles with GPU device, samples and noise threshold, denoise, light paths, motion blur, color management (AgX, look, exposure), output path and format, frame range, and a Render Animation button with progress.

starters.title: Sunset color grade
starters.prompt: A color grading workspace for a sunset photo: the image preview, an RGB histogram, RGB curves with C/R/G/B channels, white balance (temperature, tint), exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, and preset buttons.

starters.title: Modular synth patch
starters.prompt: A modular synth patch editor: a node graph with two oscillators, a mixer, a resonant filter, an ADSR envelope, an LFO modulating cutoff and an output, plus a sidebar with the waveform selector, cutoff and resonance knobs, an envelope curve and a spectrum histogram.

starters.title: RPG character creator
starters.prompt: A fantasy RPG character creator: race and class with icons, a name field, stat sliders with points remaining, skin, hair and eye colors, an equipment list, a preset selector and an emote pie menu on the E key.

starters.title: Smart greenhouse
starters.prompt: A smart greenhouse dashboard: four growing zones each with temperature, humidity and a grow-light color and on/off toggle, an irrigation schedule list, a 24-hour humidity histogram, and alerts.

starters.title: Sci-fi level outliner
starters.prompt: An outliner and properties editor for a sci-fi game level: collections of rooms, lights, props and enemies in a tree with hide/render/select toggles, a search field, and the selected enemy's AI settings (patrol route, aggression, perception radius, team).

starters.title: Drone survey mission
starters.prompt: A drone survey mission planner: a list of waypoints with position, altitude and speed, a gimbal direction ball, camera settings, battery and flight-time estimate, the mission map image and Upload / Start buttons.

starters.title: Bouncing ball animation
starters.prompt: An animation panel for a bouncing ball: location and scale with keyframe decorators, squash and stretch amount, f-curve interpolation and easing, frame range and current frame, a playblast video with controls, and a keymap hint row.

starters.title: Deploy pipeline DAG
starters.prompt: A deployment pipeline for a web app as a node graph: checkout, build, unit and e2e tests, security scan, canary at 5% and full rollout, with a stage list showing progress, a log, and Promote / Rollback buttons.
